recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized, dark silhouette of a human profile facing left, featuring a hollowed-out skull top showing a white interior. A sharp yellow beam of light projects from the eye area, while the back of the head transitions into a series of serrated, leaf-like or fin-like dark shapes. The entire composition is set against a vibrant, flat red field.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the dark charcoal silhouette and the saturated red background.
Geometric tension between the sharp yellow light beam and the organic serrated tail.
Visual weight concentrated in the center-left, balanced by the upward-sweeping tail on the right.
Thin horizontal lines anchoring the typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreInvariants: Dark grey/black silhouette with soft airbrushed edges
Hollowed-out top of the head with a white/grey inner surface
Yellow triangular light beam emanating from the eye

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central profile occupies approximately 60% of the canvas, positioned slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark mass of the face serves as the primary anchor, contrasted by the bright yellow eye-beam.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the yellow beam to the left, then tracks back across the head to the serrated tail, finally moving up to the typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive red negative space surrounds the central figure, creating a sense of isolation and intensity.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with a low-value central subject; accents are high-value and high-chroma.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name in wide-tracked, thin sans-serif capitals.
Secondary name in a fluid, connected script with elongated descenders and ascenders.
Integration with thin horizontal rules that underline and frame the text.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' in the script is oversized and loops into the following letters.
The final 'e' has a long horizontal tail extending into a graphic line.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A wide-spaced geometric sans-serif paired with a loose, hand-drawn monoline script.

preserve: Wide tracking for the upper text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn 80s feel of the script.
Matches the clean, geometric feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat, vibrant red background. In the center-left, place a dark charcoal silhouette of a human profile facing left. The top of the head should be sliced off at an angle to reveal a white/grey interior. A sharp, solid yellow triangle should project from the eye area. The back of the head should transition into three serrated, leaf-like dark shapes curving upwards. Use soft airbrushing on the edges of the dark silhouette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: In the top right quadrant, add two lines of text. The top line should be in a thin, wide-tracked sans-serif. The bottom line should be a larger, thin monoline script. Add two thin horizontal black lines: one underlining the top text and one extending from the end of the script text.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated red?
Does the silhouette have a hollowed-out top?
Is the yellow beam a sharp geometric triangle?
Is the typography thin and positioned in the top right?

adjustableVariables: Width of the yellow light beam
mustRedesign: Specific brand names or artist names

mustAchieve: Subtle airbrushed depth within the silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow beam does not have a gradient.
Check that the serrated tail shapes are distinct and dark.
Verify the white interior of the head is visible.
Confirm the text does not overlap the main illustration.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a surrealist silhouette with a geometric light source against a high-saturation field, using 80s-style thin-line typography for a retro-modern graphic look.
